chunks.body:
Welcome to Riverbend Unified
Riverbend Unified School District serves 9,400 students in 14 schools. Our mission is that every student graduates ready for college, career and community.

Quick links for families
Find the district calendar, bus routes, enrollment steps and the student handbook using the links above.

chunks.body:
Cell Phones and Personal Devices
Students may bring cell phones to school.
Phones must be turned off and stored in backpacks from the first bell to the last bell.
Students may use phones during lunch only at high schools.
A phone used during class will be held in the main office until the end of the day.
After a second violation, a parent must pick up the phone.
chunks.title: Student Handbook 2026-27 (PDF)

chunks.body:
Grading
Report cards are issued at the end of each semester.
Progress reports are available in the parent portal every six weeks.
chunks.title: Student Handbook 2026-27 (PDF)

chunks.body:
Dress Code
Clothing must cover the torso from the shoulders to mid-thigh.
Hats may be worn outdoors only.
Clothing with images of drugs, alcohol, weapons or hate symbols is not allowed.
chunks.title: Student Handbook 2026-27 (PDF)

2026-27 District Calendar
The first day of school for students is Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The last day of school is Thursday, June 3, 2027.

Breaks and holidays
Labor Day: Monday, September 7, 2026 (no school)
Thanksgiving break: Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026
Winter break: Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. Classes resume Monday, January 4, 2027.
Spring break: Monday, March 29 through Friday, April 2, 2027

Transportation
Riverbend Unified provides free bus transportation to students who live more than 1.5 miles from their assigned school.

Finding your bus stop
Families can look up their bus stop and pickup time with the Stop Finder app. Enter your home address and your student's grade to see the stop. Routes are posted on August 1 each year.

Bus rider rules
Students must be at the stop five minutes before the scheduled pickup time. The driver will not wait for late students.
Questions about routes can go to the Transportation Office at (555) 010-2045, open 6:30 am to 4:30 pm on school days.

chunks.body:
Enrollment & Registration
New students enroll online through the district registration portal. Registration for the 2026-27 school year opens on February 2, 2026.

Documents you need
Proof of the child's age, such as a birth certificate or passport
Two proofs of residency in Riverbend, such as a utility bill and a lease or mortgage statement dated within 60 days
Immunization records
The most recent report card or transcript, if the student attended another school

Kindergarten
Children must turn five on or before September 1 to enroll in kindergarten. Transitional kindergarten is open to children who turn four by September 1.

chunks.body:
Attendance
Regular attendance matters. When your child is absent, a parent or guardian must call the school attendance line or use the parent app before 9:00 am on the day of the absence.

Excused absences
Absences are excused for illness, medical or dental appointments, a death in the immediate family, and religious observances. A note is required within three school days of the student's return.

Chronic absence
Students who miss 10 percent or more of school days are considered chronically absent. The school will contact the family to make a support plan after the fifth unexcused absence.
chunks.heading: Excused absences

chunks.body:
Medication at School
All medication taken at school, including over-the-counter medicine, requires a Medication Authorization Form signed by a parent and a licensed health care provider.
Medicine must be brought to the school nurse by an adult in the original labeled container. Students may carry asthma inhalers and epinephrine auto-injectors with written permission.
